```python
# 4. under threshold: fresh + calm. Re-arm so a later re-crossing fires again.
if used is None or used < threshold:

        idempotency.clear_fired(session_id, COMPACT_EVENT, state_dir=state_dir)   # <-- Phase 19: clears at <60

# 5. at/over threshold: fire ONCE per crossing (idempotent — D-15).
if idempotency.already_fired(session_id, COMPACT_EVENT, state_dir=state_dir):
    return event("no_op", "already_armed", used)
idempotency.record_fired(session_id, COMPACT_EVENT, used, state_dir=state_dir)     # <-- Phase 19: arms on DECISION
# OBSERVE-ONLY: we LOG the decision; we send NO keystroke and call NO cco-dream.
return event("would_compact", "threshold_crossed", used)
```

<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| daemon (launchd, act mode) -> operator's live tmux pane | evaluate_session now enacts the send; the decision to fire is gated by threshold + arm state + idle + marker + the act toggle. |
| config.json (act toggle) -> daemon each poll | The single switch between observe-only and acting; read fail-closed each poll. |
| registry `%N` (per session_id) -> the send target | The pane is resolved by session_id (never a session name); only discovered fresh-bridge sessions are evaluated. |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-20-03 | Spoofing/Tampering (mis-route) | evaluate_session -> pane target | mitigate | pane resolved by session_id from the registry (never a name); only fresh-bridge (discovered) sessions are evaluated; a gone pane fails the capture-pane idle probe (busy_skip). unmapped -> no send. Verified: test_act_only_on_mapped_pane. |
| T-20-04 | DoS (context-wipe spam) | step 4/5 arm + re-arm | mitigate | arm-on-send fire-once (D-05: busy_skip/deduped do NOT arm), one send per arming (D-06), re-arm only below the 45% band (D-07) so a lingering >60% session is never re-fired. Verified: test_fire_once_arm_on_send, test_rearm_hysteresis_band. |
| T-20-05 | Elevation (act without intent) | main() act toggle read | mitigate | act defaults False through poll_once/evaluate_session; main() reads config.act_enabled (safe-default-off) each poll — the daemon acts only when the operator has explicitly enabled it. Verified: test_observe_only_no_send. |
| T-20-01 | Tampering/Elevation | action.send_compact argv | mitigate | daemon composes action.send_compact (argv list, %N element) — never builds a shell string or a raw send-keys itself (D-01). Verified: grep (no send-keys in daemon.py) + test_compact_send_keys_argv. |
</threat_model>
